department: Department of Mathematical Sciences, Division of Statistics and Data Science

deadline.value: No fixed deadline is stated; applications are received until positions are filled, with reviews from February 1 and visa applicants needing materials by April 1.
deadline.quote: We will continue to receive applications until all positions are filled.

also.quote: Completed applications will be reviewed beginning February 1.
All application materials from international students requiring a US visa must be received prior to April 1 (but sooner is better)

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; students who took it can upload the score sheet.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required, but if you have taken the GRE, please upload a copy of your score sheet.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Applicants should hold or expect a bachelor's degree in statistics or a related area.
entry_route.quote: Students applying for the program should have or be expecting to obtain a bachelor’s degree in statistics or a related area.

funding.value: Most PhD students receive full financial support through a teaching or research assistantship, a fellowship or an internship.
funding.quote: Most of our PhD students receive full financial support (tuition remission and a Graduate Assistantship, a fellowship, or an internship), and most are supported through their entire UC career.

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor rule.

notes: The handbook (2023) states a GRE quantitative minimum of 160 for admission; the main page says it is recommended. The Biomedical Biostatistics PhD in the College of Medicine (med.uc.edu/education/bmi-grad/phd) was not researched.
